title: Validate a JSON script parameter
purpose: Read Get ( ScriptParameter ), reject empty or malformed JSON and unsupported contracts, and pass only validated values to later work.
preconditions: The caller and callee agree on a versioned JSON parameter contract.
Every required key and its expected value type is explicitly defined before implementation.
The logging policy identifies sensitive keys whose values must not be logged.

steps.name: Set Error Capture
steps.purpose: Make error handling explicit before JSON calculations and branching.

partialConditions.psos: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.
partialConditions.server_schedule: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.

steps.name: Set Variable
steps.purpose: Store the original parameter, formatted JSON, extracted values, and result JSON in local variables.

steps.name: If
steps.purpose: Branch on empty input, invalid JSON, contract version, required keys, and permitted type checks.

steps.name: Exit Script
steps.purpose: Return the common JSON result immediately on validation failure.

functions.name: JSONFormatElements
functions.purpose: Attempt to parse and normalize the JSON text before consuming values.

functions.name: JSONListKeys
functions.purpose: Inspect object keys when enforcing the resolved required-key list.

functions.name: JSONGetElement
functions.purpose: Read schemaVersion and resolved contract fields.

functions.name: JSONSetElement
functions.purpose: Build the common success or error result without string concatenation.

happyPath: Store Get ( ScriptParameter ) in a local variable.
Reject an empty value before attempting JSON access.
Use JSONFormatElements and reject a parse failure before reading keys.
Compare schemaVersion with {{EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION}} and reject unknown versions.
Check every key in {{REQUIRED_JSON_KEYS}} and only the value types that the resolved contract can test unambiguously.
Copy validated values, not the untrusted raw string, into local variables for subsequent patterns.
Return OK only if every required check has passed.

errorBranches.trigger: Get ( ScriptParameter ) returns an empty value.
errorBranches.action: Return a common error result with fileMakerCode null.

errorBranches.trigger: JSONFormatElements cannot parse the supplied text.
errorBranches.action: Return a common error result without logging the raw payload.

errorBranches.trigger: schemaVersion is absent or differs from {{EXPECTED_SCHEMA_VERSION}}.
errorBranches.action: Reject the request; do not guess a migration.
Return the missing key name only when that disclosure is safe.

errorBranches.trigger: A resolved contract field cannot be consumed as its declared value type.
errorBranches.action: Return a generic validation failure and do not coerce ambiguous business data.

concurrencyNotes: Validation uses only local variables and has no shared record state.
A requestId may be validated here, but duplicate-request handling belongs to the later write or PSOS pattern.
securityNotes: Never log the complete parameter by default.
Redact values for {{SENSITIVE_JSON_KEYS}} and avoid echoing secrets in error details.
Reject unexpected schema versions instead of accepting a wider payload implicitly.
